gap_assessment.allowed_wording: Prior work studies Rubik's Cube skill acquisition, decomposition, algorithms, expertise and performance, while broader process-tracing and digital-trace literatures emphasize measurement validity. In this bounded targeted search, we did not identify a directly analogous study that validates public speedcubing reconstruction traces through a succession of state-exact observation operators with separate null, transport, provenance and claim-authority courts.
prohibited_wording: This is the first study of observation operators in speedcubing.
No prior work has validated reconstruction traces.
CUBE-REV is uniquely the first framework of its kind.
